task_definition.title: Share mesh_aabb test helper via reify-test-support (dedup 5 copies)
task_definition.description: The private test helper `mesh_aabb` — computes a tessellated Mesh's AABB (min/max [f32;3]) from its flat vertex buffer — is copy-pasted verbatim across 5 sites: crates/reify-eval/tests/{affine_apply_e2e.rs, geometry_conditional_e2e.rs, sub_placement_assembly_gate.rs, sub_placement_surfacing.rs} and the #[cfg(test)] module in crates/reify-kernel-occt/src/lib.rs. Add one shared `mesh_aabb(&Mesh) -> ([f32;3],[f32;3])` to reify-test-support (already imported by all 4 reify-eval e2e tests) and re-point every call site at it. Note: reify-kernel-occt's copy is cfg(test)-private and would need reify-test-support in its dev-dependencies (or its own exported helper) to share cross-crate — include it or explicitly note it stays local. Surfaced by task 3963 code review (reviewer_comprehensive, test_duplication finding, esc-3963-99); low-severity/optional cleanup, no production-behavior change.
